learning.summary_zh: George 穿 T-rex 裝在客廳拿木叉追姐姐，被罵 wild thing、罰回房不准吃晚飯。房間長出叢林，Billy o' Tea 載他到野獸島。他用眼神馴服 Horn、Beak、Goat，當王跳 wild parade；肚子餓後自願留下王冠回家，晚飯還熱。
focus_en: Story words: wild thing, jungle, stare, crown, parade
Home words: wooden fork, living room, supper
Key phrases: I am not afraid. Come and eat, wild thing.
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：Mummy 為什麼叫 George wild thing？（他拿木叉在客廳追 Sylvia）
問：George 怎樣成為國王？（盯著野獸的黃眼睛，不怕）
問：王冠後來呢？（留給 Horn，沒有帶回家）
問：回到房間時晚飯怎麼樣？（還熱，全家等他）

vocab.example: Mummy called George a wild thing, then later a soft wild thing.
vocab.alt: Mummy calling George a wild thing in the living room

vocab.example: Sylvia said the wooden fork was only a play fork.
vocab.alt: George chasing Sylvia with a wooden play fork

vocab.example: Green vines grew into a jungle, but his bed stayed.
George stared into their yellow eyes and was not afraid.
vocab.alt: George staring into the yellow eyes of the wild things

vocab.example: Beak put a vine crown on George's dinosaur hood.
vocab.alt: a leafy vine crown on George's hood

vocab.example: Goat said, let the wild parade begin!
vocab.alt: George and the wild things stomping in a parade

vocab.example: The quiet room felt lonely without his family.
vocab.alt: George sitting alone on his cream bed

vocab.example: His supper was still hot when he came home.
vocab.alt: a steaming supper tray on the bed with the family

pages.alt: In the living room George in a T-rex onesie chases Sylvia with a wooden play fork; she laughs

lines.text: After tea, George stomped through the living room in his T-rex suit.
Roar! I am the biggest dinosaur in this whole house!
George, stop chasing me with that silly wooden fork!
No way! Wild T-rex George will catch you soon!

pages.alt: Mummy stands by the living-room door and sends George to his room; Sylvia watches

lines.text: George! You are being a wild thing, not a kind brother!
Wild things do not have to listen to anyone!
No supper. Go to your room and stay there now.
Maybe next time play without the fork, George.

pages.alt: George sits alone on his cream bed with the bird lamp glowing

lines.text: George marched to his room and shut the door with a loud thump.
Fine! I do not even want any stupid supper tonight!
His tummy rumbled, but nobody came to the door.
They all love Sylvia more than they love me.

pages.alt: Green vines climb the cream bedroom walls; the bed and bird lamp remain

lines.text: Green vines crept up the cream wall beside his beige headboard.
Wait… my bed is still here under all these leaves.
The little bird lamp glowed warm through the curling jungle.
Even the grey curtains look like tall trees now.

pages.alt: A small tea-brown boat with a tea-leaf sail waits beside George's bed

lines.text: A small wooden boat pushed through the leaves beside his bed.
Billy o' Tea! You came just for me!
Tea-brown sails rose up; a leaf emblem shone soft and gold.
I will sail away and find my own wild land!

pages.alt: George steers the small Billy o' Tea alone under a lavender sky

lines.text: George steered past fern waves under a wide lavender sky.
The sea smells like rain and something sweet.
His room faded behind him, but the bird lamp light followed.
Keep going, Billy. I am not turning back yet.

pages.alt: Three huge wild things block the shore; George stands brave at the boat

lines.text: Who dares land on our island with small blue shoes?
Look at those teeth on his hood! Show your claws!
Three wild ones block the shore. Step back, small boy.
I am not small. I am George, and I am brave.

pages.alt: George stares into yellow eyes; Beak sets a vine crown on his hood

lines.text: Stop. Look at my eyes. I am not afraid of you.
The yellow-eyed beasts went quiet and lowered their sharp claws.
You stared us down. You must be our king now.
Wear this vine crown. Rule the wild things well.

pages.alt: George and the three wild things stomp and leap in a wild parade

lines.text: Let the wild parade begin! Stomp and swirl with us!
Higher! We leap like storm clouds over the moon!
King George, your roar is the loudest of all!
Again! Again! The island shakes with happy feet!

pages.alt: After the dance George holds his tummy; Goat speaks gently; the boat waits

lines.text: My tummy is empty. I wish I smelled hot soup.
The vine crown felt heavy; the jungle night felt far from home.
Kings can leave whenever their hearts pull homeward.
The place that loves me most is waiting for me.

pages.alt: George sails away on Billy o' Tea; Horn holds the crown on the shore

lines.text: Goodbye, wild friends. I must go back home now.
Sail safe, little king. We will keep your crown.
Tell your family the wild things said hello.
Billy o' Tea turned toward the distant bird-lamp glow.

pages.alt: Back in the bedroom the family waits with a steaming supper; George still wears the T-rex hood

lines.text: George stepped into his room. Supper steamed on a tray.
We kept your plate hot. Come and eat, wild thing.
Welcome home, George. We missed our brave little king.
Next time chase me with hugs, not a fork!

quiz.q: What was the name of the little boat?
How did George tame the wild things?
options: He hit them with the fork
He stared into their yellow eyes

quiz.q: Who put the vine crown on George?
What did George do with the crown?
options: He took it home to bed
He threw it in the sea

quiz.q: What was waiting in his room?
